title: Franchise Hierarchy Reconstruction
scenario: Reconstruct the entire lineage of a game franchise. For a given game, find all ancestors (parent, grandparent, etc.). Return 'game_id' and 'lineage_depth'.
hint: Use a Recursive CTE to traverse parent_game_id links.
correctQuery: WITH RECURSIVE lineage AS (SELECT game_id, parent_game_id, 0 AS depth FROM game_sequences WHERE game_id = 101 UNION ALL SELECT gs.game_id, gs.parent_game_id, l.depth + 1 FROM game_sequences gs JOIN lineage l ON gs.game_id = l.parent_game_id) SELECT game_id, depth AS lineage_depth FROM lineage;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE game_sequences (game_id INT, parent_game_id INT);
